name: Cooperative Association for Agricultural Development and Environment – Gaza (CAADE)

profile.name: Cooperative Association for Agricultural Development and Environment – Gaza (CAADE)
profile.vision: A pioneering cooperative association that strengthens the resilience and empowerment of its members and the local community, and serves as an innovative cooperative model for sustainable agricultural development.
profile.origin: The Cooperative Association for Agricultural Development and Environment – Gaza (CAADE) was established in 2021 by a group of professionals with experience in agricultural development, cooperative work, environmental management, and development and humanitarian projects. CAADE is an independent Palestinian cooperative association officially registered with the Palestinian Ministry of Labour – Cooperative Work Sector under registration number 1696, with legal personality and financial and administrative autonomy in accordance with Palestinian cooperative legislation.
profile.about:
The Cooperative Association for Agricultural Development and Environment – Gaza (CAADE) is an independent Palestinian cooperative association established in 2021, with legal personality and financial and administrative autonomy, officially registered with the Palestinian Ministry of Labour – Cooperative Work Sector. The Association works to serve its members, farmers, and local communities, and to promote sustainable economic, social, and environmental development in the Gaza Strip.

In light of the humanitarian, economic, and environmental challenges facing the Gaza Strip, particularly the consequences of the war since October 2023, the Association adopts an integrated approach that combines humanitarian response, early recovery, and sustainable development. Its interventions focus on food security, restoring and developing agricultural production and livelihoods, economic empowerment, sustainable agricultural and environmental solutions, efficient resource use, and climate change adaptation.

The Association embraces the principles of cooperative action and the Social and Solidarity Economy (SSE) through developing innovative cooperative economic models, strengthening local production, cooperative services and assets, value chains, and marketing, thereby contributing to improved livelihoods, strengthened resilience, and self-reliance.

The Association implements its programmes for both members and non-members, prioritizing farmers, women, youth, and the most vulnerable and affected households. Building on its experience and national and international partnerships, CAADE seeks, through its strategic plan, to strengthen its role as an effective cooperative and development partner in the Gaza Strip.
profile.mission: We are a cooperative association for agricultural development and the environment, dedicated to serving our members and the local community and strengthening our institutional capacities through the development of innovative cooperative economic models, the advancement of agricultural production, value chains, and cooperative marketing, the application of modern technologies, and the implementation of sustainable development programmes guided by the principles of the Social and Solidarity Economy (SSE). Through these efforts, we promote participation, equity, and solidarity, support the recovery and resilience of the agricultural sector, improve livelihoods, and contribute to environmental sustainability and national development.
profile.values: Cooperation and solidarity; empowerment and democratic participation; transparency and accountability; justice, equality, and inclusion; sustainability; innovation and responsiveness to change; professionalism and institutional excellence; partnership and collaboration.
profile.address: Palestine – Gaza – Al-Rimal Al-Gharbi – The Beach
profile.heroIntro: A Palestinian cooperative operating in line with the principles of the Social and Solidarity Economy to advance sustainable agricultural and environmental development and empower communities in the Gaza Strip.

programs.title: Institutional Excellence and Capacity Building
programs.description: Strengthening institutional capacities and governance, and improving systems of efficiency, sustainability, and development impact.

programs.title: Contributing to the Rehabilitation and Sustainable Development of the Agricultural Sector
programs.description: Supporting the recovery of the agricultural sector, enhancing its productivity, and strengthening its resilience and sustainability.

programs.title: Agricultural Value Chain Development and Cooperative Marketing
programs.description: Enhancing the economic value of agricultural products and improving their competitiveness through integrated value chains and effective cooperative marketing.

programs.title: Recovery, Sustainable Livelihoods, and Community Resilience
programs.description: Responding to urgent needs and supporting early recovery, while empowering local communities to restore sustainable and dignified livelihoods.

programs.title: Environmental Management and Climate-Smart Sustainable Agriculture
programs.description: Protecting the environment and natural resources, and promoting climate-smart agriculture and sustainable practices to address climate change.

news.title: The Association’s Participation in the “Made in Gaza (Stories of Hope)” Exhibition
news.excerpt: Participation in the “Made in Gaza” Exhibition organized by the Democracy and Workers’ Rights Center.
news.description: In October 2026, the Cooperative Association for Agricultural Development and Environment – Gaza participated in the “Made in Gaza (Stories of Hope)” Exhibition, showcasing local agricultural products and highlighting community resilience.

news.title: Study and Assessment of the Olive and Olive Oil Sector
news.excerpt: Field assessment of the olive sector in Gaza in cooperation with the Land Research Center and the Ministry of Agriculture.
news.description: In September 2026, CAADE, in cooperation with the Land Research Center and the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, organized a comprehensive field study and assessment of the olive and olive oil sector across the Gaza Strip.

news.title: Consultative Meeting with the International Labour Organization (ILO)
news.excerpt: Exploring interventions and prospects for strengthening the agricultural sector and employment.
news.description: In May 2026, the Association held a consultative meeting with the International Labour Organization (ILO) and agricultural cooperatives on potential interventions and prospects for strengthening the agricultural sector and employment.

news.title: Closing Meeting of the Gaza Recovery and Reconstruction Dialogues
news.excerpt: Participating in discussions on Gaza’s recovery at the invitation of the Ministry of Planning and the United Nations.
news.description: In November 2025, CAADE participated in the closing meeting of the week of discussions and dialogues on Gaza's recovery and reconstruction, organized by the Ministry of Planning and the United Nations.

news.title: Gaza Recovery Discussions with Public and Private Sectors
news.excerpt: Dialogue alongside public and private sector institutions on recovery and reconstruction.
news.description: The Association participated alongside public and private sector institutions in discussions on Gaza's recovery and reconstruction, at the invitation of the Ministry of Planning and the United Nations (November 2025).

news.title: Civil Society Discussions on Gaza’s Recovery and Reconstruction
news.excerpt: Consultations on cooperative and agricultural priorities in early recovery.
news.description: In November 2025, CAADE joined civil society organizations in consultative sessions on Gaza's recovery and reconstruction, convened by the Ministry of Planning and the United Nations.

news.title: Al-Ahba Cooperative School Initiative for 470 Displaced Children
news.excerpt: Establishing an educational learning centre in Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis – Bir 20.
news.description: As part of CAADE's community initiatives, an educational learning centre (Al-Ahba Cooperative School) was established to provide education for 470 displaced children in Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis – Bir 20, in partnership with Women’s Affairs Center and Oxfam.

news.title: General Assembly Meeting and Elections of Board and Supervisory Committee
news.excerpt: Democratic elections for the 2025–2028 term under the patronage of the Cooperative Work Authority.
news.description: On 20 August 2025, CAADE held its General Assembly meeting under the patronage of the Cooperative Work Authority, successfully electing the 7-member Management Committee and 3-member Supervisory Committee for 2025–2028.

news.title: Fresh Food Supplies for Displaced Families in Southern Gaza
news.excerpt: Distributing fresh food and produce, generously funded by Firdaous Charity France in partnership with Taawon.
news.description: CAADE implemented the 'Providing Fresh Food Supplies to Displaced Families in the Southern Gaza Strip (2024)' project, generously funded by Firdaous Charity France, in partnership with Taawon (Welfare Association).

news.title: Humanitarian Assistance to Displacement Camps in Rafah
news.excerpt: Delivering relief and essential food supplies to displaced families in Rafah.
news.description: In 2024, the Association provided urgent humanitarian assistance to displacement camps in Rafah in cooperation and coordination with international humanitarian organizations.

news.title: Workshop on National Priorities for the Cooperative Sector (2024–2029)
news.excerpt: Advancing the cooperative sector within the framework of the Cooperative Work Authority’s strategy.
news.description: CAADE participated in the national workshop on “National Priorities for the Development and Advancement of the Cooperative Sector within the Framework of the Cooperative Work Authority’s Strategy (2024–2029)”.

news.title: Training Programme on “Management of Agricultural Cooperative Associations” with the ILO
news.excerpt: Strengthening management, financial, and operational capacity of agricultural cooperatives.
news.description: CAADE staff participated in the specialized training programme on the “Management of Agricultural Cooperative Associations” organized in collaboration with the International Labour Organization (ILO).

news.title: Roots Summer Pioneers Camp “Stars, Not Numbers” (2023)
news.excerpt: Youth and children's developmental summer camp under the Higher Council for Youth and Sports.
news.description: CAADE organized the Roots Summer Pioneers Camp under the patronage of the Palestinian Higher Council for Youth and Sports under the motto “Stars, Not Numbers” (2023), supporting psychological and social well-being.

news.title: Table Thyme Cultivation and Production through a Value Chain Approach
news.excerpt: Establishing drying and processing units to build sustainable income for farmers.
news.description: Implementing table thyme cultivation and drying activities through a value chain approach, equipping farmers with sorting, packaging, and marketing capacities to enhance agricultural livelihoods.

news.title: Participation in Discussion of Draft Palestinian Social Security Law
news.excerpt: Advocating for the rights and social protection of farmers and cooperative members.
news.description: CAADE actively participated in national policy dialogues on the draft Palestinian Social Security Law, ensuring the inclusion of agricultural workers and smallholder farmers in social protection systems.

news.title: Strengthening Cooperation with Zeina Cooperative Association
news.excerpt: Putting into action the cooperative principle of 'Cooperation among Cooperatives'.
news.description: CAADE established formal collaborative ties with Zeina Cooperative Association, in line with the universal cooperative principle of cooperation among cooperatives, to exchange expertise and shared assets.

news.title: Discussions with Al-Baraka Insurance Company on Agricultural Insurance
news.excerpt: Exploring agricultural risk protection mechanisms for greenhouse farmers in Gaza.
news.description: CAADE held working sessions with Al-Baraka Insurance Company to discuss ways to provide agricultural insurance for farmers in the protected agriculture sector, safeguarding producers against losses.

news.title: Multi-Sectoral Needs Response Project – Cash for Work Component
news.excerpt: Providing dignified employment and livelihood support funded by Sida via Islamic Relief.
news.description: CAADE implemented the cash-for-work component of the Multi-Sectoral Response project for conflict-affected households in Gaza, funded by Sida and implemented by Gaza Culture Group through Islamic Relief Palestine.
